title: Known-truth predictive functional equivalence and independent-donor rescue calibration
question: Can a cross-fitted finite camera recover the least-complex margin-separated predictive class, abstain on ambiguity, and rescue a blocked path with an independently estimated donor rather than an algebraic replay?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Cross-fitted predictive class, explicit abstention, held-out factorial response, independent donor rescue, wrong donor and algebraic replay sentinel.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: All 320 systems recover their reference-risk functional class or abstention, and every independently sourced confirmation gate passes in both registry splits.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: Any functional class is mistyped, any ambiguous system is forced through, or any independent rescue gate fails.

hypothesis_predictions.observable: The same frozen predictive-equivalence and independent-rescue battery.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: Finite observations cannot recover a stable minimal predictive quotient or distinguish independently sourced rescue from wrong donors.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: Exact functional typing, abstention, independent rescue, controls and split breadth all pass.

data_contract.cluster_unit: One source family, registry split, task and replicate; source labels remain private and are not the estimand.
data_contract.split_rule: Two 768-case reference panels define private truth after a separate 1024-case reference fit; discovery, selection, donor-discovery and confirmation are independently seeded.
data_contract.answer_payload_rule: Source family and reference risks remain private until adjudication; all overlap and out-of-library systems remain in the denominator.

factor_design.truth_rule: least complexity with max reference risk <=0.050 and all earlier risks >=0.120

metrics.threshold_source: Frozen after a 72-system development probe and before formal material generation.

metrics.estimator: Relative A1 and J response error on an independent confirmation partition.
Oracle block plus donor-discovery fitted rescue, wrong identity rejection and donor-source gap.
Exact subtract/add replay must be detected as a tautological positive sentinel and excluded from mediation evidence.
Minimum class count, cross-source alias and split conjunction.

typed_gates.rule: Predictive class and abstention accuracy equal one across all 320 systems.
Every actionable system passes frozen A1, J, identity, nuisance and manifold thresholds.
Every actionable system blocks the target channel, is rescued by an independently fitted donor, rejects wrong donors, and has nonzero donor-source gap.
Exact removed-channel replay returns the target up to floating error but contributes no mediation evidence.
Every class has at least 20 systems, at least one predictive class spans source families, and every system passes in both splits.

budget.right_censoring_rule: Any conjunctive failure stops C013 before free-network or pretrained-model execution.

stopping_rules: No source-family label is exposed before adjudication.
No candidate, threshold, class margin or family changes after preregistration.
Algebraic replay is never counted as rescue evidence.

adjudication.failure_claim: Functional type recovery was 318/320 and abstention was 82/84. Two frozen equivalence-overlap systems had one reference panel just above the 0.050 linear-risk boundary but fell just below it on selection, so they were incorrectly authorized as linear. All applicable confirmation, independent-donor rescue, wrong-identity, control and algebraic-sentinel gates passed. The result blocks free-network execution without repairing thresholds or deleting boundary systems.

authorizes_on_pass: one separately frozen cross-depth free-Transformer predictive-equivalence phase
